mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dart_corp_code (corp_code, stock_code, corp_name, corp_eng_name, modify_date) VALUES
(#{item.corpCode}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.corpName}, #{item.corpEngName}, #{item.modifyDate})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_code = VALUES(stock_code), corp_name = VALUES(corp_name), corp_eng_name = VALUES(corp_eng_name), modify_date = VALUES(modify_date), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT corp_code, stock_code, corp_name, corp_eng_name, modify_date FROM dart_corp_code WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT corp_code, stock_code, corp_name, corp_eng_name, modify_date FROM dart_corp_code WHERE corp_code = #{corpCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.corp_code, d.stock_code, d.corp_name, d.corp_eng_name, d.modify_date FROM dart_corp_code d LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON sm.stock_code = d.stock_code WHERE d.stock_code IS NOT NULL AND d.stock_code != '' AND (sm.stock_code IS NULL OR sm.is_active = 0) AND ( d.corp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR d.stock_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ORDER BY d.corp_name, d.stock_code LIMIT #{limit}
